test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 30 Dec, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
In a certain code language,

‘A ± B’ means ‘A is the wife of B’,

‘A * B’ means ‘A is the daughter of B’,

‘A ₹ B’ means ‘A is the father of B’ and

‘A # B’ means ‘A is the brother of B’.

How is D related to O if ‘D # R * A ± C ₹ O’?
solution:
Family Chart:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/47a89a5bb9daa01f32d67cf5151f1acc95989e845ae3c3eb86353e0d1da9cbdc.png] 

Decoding the Symbols:

 
 

 Symbol
 ±
 *
 ₹
 #
 
 
 
 

 Meaning
 Wife
 Daughter
 Father
 Brother
 
 

Given: D # R * A ± C ₹ O

It means: D is the brother of R, R is the daughter of A, A is the wife of C, and C is the father of O.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/21296e10cc738381ce55f3c527a0e9ca9ef547b8b9ea8d1e7b95955240c02dec.png] 

 

So, D is the brother of O.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3".**
